evidence.detail: load_competitions() already SELECTs season.season_id, so data is available in the Competition model
Competition view never reads competition.season_id or converts it to a display name; template therefore has no season variable to render
Template shows no season info or league end date; only start_date is surfaced via self.date in the view

triage.fix_sketch: In decksite/views/competition.py __init__, add self.season_num = competition.season_id (already loaded by SQL) and self.end_date = dtutil.display_date(competition.end_date). In decksite/templates/competition.mustache, add a header or subtitle line like 'Season {{season_num}}' and for leagues show the date range using {{end_date}}. No schema or data changes needed.
triage.notes: season_id is already loaded in the SQL query; the fix is purely in the view and template layers. end_date is also already loaded (data/competition.py:55) but not displayed.
